title: 🔥 THE GREAT COMMISSION & DISCIPLESHIP—ARE YOU READY TO BE A GOSPEL WARRIOR? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE GREAT COMMISSION & DISCIPLESHIP—ARE YOU READY TO BE A GOSPEL WARRIOR? 🔥
💬 "Brother John, I know Jesus told us to spread the Gospel, but how do I actually live that out? What does discipleship really mean?"

🚨 THE CHURCH HAS FORGOTTEN ITS GREATEST MISSION! Today, many Christians think faith is just about attending church, singing songs, and living a comfortable life. But Jesus gave us a COMMAND—not a suggestion!

📖 Key Verse: "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all that I have commanded you." (Matthew 28:19-20)
🔥 JESUS’ FINAL INSTRUCTION WAS NOT TO SIT IN CHURCH—IT WAS TO GO AND MAKE DISCIPLES! 🔥

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE GREAT COMMISSION?
📖 Mark 16:15 – "Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation."

💡 THE GREAT COMMISSION = JESUS' FINAL MISSION FOR US!
✔️ GO – Not just sit and wait—GO and preach the Gospel!
✔️ MAKE DISCIPLES – Not just converts, but committed followers of Christ.
✔️ TEACH THEM TO OBEY – True faith leads to transformation!
🚨 Too many Christians live like secret agents—hiding their faith and never making disciples. THAT ENDS TODAY!

🔥 2. WHY DISCIPLESHIP IS NOT OPTIONAL!
📖 Luke 9:23 – "If anyone would come after me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me."
Discipleship is not just knowing about Jesus—it’s living like Jesus!

✔️ A DISCIPLE IS SOMEONE WHO FOLLOWS, LEARNS, AND LIVES LIKE CHRIST.
✔️ TRUE DISCIPLES TEACH OTHERS TO FOLLOW JESUS TOO!
✔️ REAL CHRISTIANITY IS NOT JUST BELIEVING—IT’S DOING!
🚨 If you are not making disciples, are you really following Jesus?

🔥 3. WHY MOST CHURCHES FAIL AT DISCIPLESHIP!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3 – "For the time will come when people will not endure sound teaching, but will gather around them teachers who say what their itching ears want to hear."

💡 THE CHURCH FOCUSES ON ENTERTAINMENT, NOT TRAINING!
❌ Many churches focus on emotions, not transformation.
❌ They produce churchgoers, not disciple-makers.
❌ Many pastors care about attendance, not obedience.
🚨 We don’t need more weak Christians—we need SPIRITUAL WARRIORS!

🔥 JOIN THE GOSPEL WARRIORS GROUP!
💥 ARE YOU READY TO BE TRAINED AS A TRUE DISCIPLE OF CHRIST?

We are forming THE GOSPEL WARRIORS GROUP—a movement of believers who are committed to:
✅ CENTERING THEIR LIVES ON CHRIST – No more lukewarm faith!
✅ MAKING THE BIBLE THEIR DAILY GUIDE – No more spiritual laziness!
✅ EVANGELIZING THE LOST – Sharing the truth boldly!
✅ EXPOSING FALSE TEACHINGS – Standing for sound doctrine!
✅ TRAINING TO BE DISCIPLE-MAKERS – Raising up warriors for God!
If you are tired of empty religion and ready to be equipped as a true follower of Jesus, join us! WE WILL TRAIN YOU TO BE A GOSPEL WARRIOR!

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I CHOOSE TO OBEY THE GREAT COMMISSION! I will live for Christ, make disciples, and spread the Gospel boldly!"

🔥 THE DISCIPLESHIP CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Commit to daily Bible reading and prayer.
✅ Step 2: Share the Gospel with at least one person this week.
✅ Step 3: Invite others to join THE GOSPEL WARRIORS GROUP!
🔥 #GospelWarriors #GreatCommission #MakeDisciples #JesusAtTheCenter #FaithInAction #GospelRevival #JohnXAsis
